title: Fitness age (GET fitnessage-service/fitnessage/<date>)
description:
Not wrapped by garminconnect — called directly via garmin.connectapi(f"fitnessage-service/fitnessage/{date}"). Found 2026-08-02 while investigating why sync_performance's fitness_age field always read null: the field it was reading (mostRecentVO2Max.generic.fitnessAge, shared with get_max_metrics/get_training_status) is dead on this account — this is the real, separate source, discovered via the Fitness Age page's network requests in Garmin Connect and confirmed against the UI's own displayed value (44.74 here vs. the in-app "improved to 44.5" notification, within rounding).

Verified against: 2026-08-02 (populated), 2026-01-01 and 2020-01-01 (stale/no data, to confirm the shape degrades gracefully on backfill rather than erroring).

chronologicalAge.description: Not consumed by sync.py — actual age, not a fitness metric.

fitnessAge.description: Consumed as performance.fitness_age. Absent entirely (not null) when the underlying rolling-average components are stale — use .get(), and expect no point written for this field on those days.

achievableFitnessAge.description: Not currently consumed by sync.py. Projected fitness age if target component values were met.

components.description: Not currently consumed by sync.py. Breakdown driving the fitnessAge computation — each component either has a value/potentialAge/priority (populated) or stale:true with staleInputs (insufficient data).
